name: cvolo-language
description: Cvolo language support for Visual Studio Code via the standalone Cvolo Language Server.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Cvolo Language Server requires filesystem-backed project files.

cvolo.server.path.description: Development/advanced-user override for the Cvolo Language Server executable. Empty uses a bundled server when present, then cvolo-language-server from PATH.

cvolo.trace.server.description: Trace communication between VS Code and the Cvolo Language Server.

scripts.check: node --check extension.js && node --check extension-runtime.js && node --check scripts/validate.js && node scripts/validate.js && node --test
